$MTZ Q3 2026: revenue $5.2B, +30% Y/Y, supported by infrastructure demand and the Superior Acquisition in Power Delivery. Operating margin was 5.3%. #earnings #industrials
$EIX Q3 2026: Revenue $4.9B, down 15% year over year, with an operating margin of 20.1% as total costs decreased. #earnings #utilities
$AMRZ Q3 2026: revenue of $3.8B, up 2% Y/Y, as resilient building materials demand and pricing offset inflation. Operating margin was 21.0%. #earnings #materials
$AA Q3 2026: revenue $3.7B, +24% Y/Y, driven by aluminum segment growth. Operating margin 15.5%; net earnings $482M and operating cash flow $643M. #earnings #materials
$DVA Q3 2026: revenue $3.6B, +5% Y/Y, driven by U.S. dialysis and ancillary services. Operating margin 14.0%; operating cash flow $519M as costs grew faster than sales. #earnings #healthcare
$DXC Q2 FY27 (preliminary): revenue $3.0B, -4% Y/Y, with insurance software revenue up 23% while other segments declined. Operating margin 1.8%; operating cash flow $217M. #earnings #tech
$NCLH Q3 2026: Revenue was flat at $2.9B as passenger ticket sales declined. Operating margin fell to 21.2% as total costs grew faster than sales. Net earnings reached $632M. #earnings #industrials

$MHK Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $2.8B, +1% Y/Y, driven by price increases offsetting soft demand. Operating margin 6.7%; operating cash flow $471M. Guides Q4 adjusted EPS to $1.35-$1.45. #earnings #consumer
